name: Mirai's Exam Preparation - The Game
source:
An 18+ Visual Novel style game where you help Mirai through a week of exams. A lighthearted adventure story with adult content.
Based on the comic Mirai's Examination Preparation on [url=https://www.patreon.com/TransformationComics]Patreon[/url]!

[From [url=https://mirai-aoki.itch.io/mirais-exam-preparation]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一款18禁视觉小说风格的游戏，你将帮助未来度过为期一周的考试。这是一则含有成人内容、氛围轻松的冒险故事。
本作改编自[url=https://www.patreon.com/TransformationComics]Patreon[/url]上的漫画《Mirai's Examination Preparation》！

[摘自[url=https://mirai-aoki.itch.io/mirais-exam-preparation]Itch.io[/url]]
